summary: Answer strict run-wide workflow inventory list questions from the complete cached index without retrieval or a model call.
decision_refs: The active goal requires continued RFI, Submittal and Email efficiency, accuracy and adaptability
The user requested Trunk Tools-style questions answered from existing project files
Current source inspection proved that list-form inventory questions still fell through to an eight-passage evidence window and model path
approval_evidence: The persistent objective and project-question request authorize this deterministic completeness and cost improvement.
known_limitations: Only exact English plural count and list forms for RFIs, Submittals and Emails use the deterministic shortcut.
Each list exposes at most 50 ordered values per category while retaining the complete total; the paginated reviewer remains the full large-inventory view.
RFI and Submittal inventory includes reference-only identifiers whose primary source may be missing.
Filtered lists remain evidence/model questions and are not claimed complete by the workflow-index shortcut.
